title: Bond hearts show in every stable row (5 hearts, tooltip 'Bond N of 10')
actual: Every row shows 5 hearts: bond 1 = half, 2 = 1 full, 5 = 2.5, 7 = 3.5, 10 = 5 full; title 'Bond N of 10'; same on 1280x720 and 390x844, no overflow. Nits: the half heart is a smaller glyph that is hard to tell from a full one at 12-14 px; a seeded bond 0 reads 'Bond 1 of 10' (clamped, fine); hearts are tiny on the phone.

title: Companion hearts drawn above party members; bond gain from riding is invisible in-session
steps: party Tuskie bond 2 + Stego bond 4, ride Tuskie for 190 sim seconds
actual: Pink hearts float over both companions (img 05). Riding 190 s moved Tuskie aff 0 -> 30 (bondSess t1:ride 30, cap) but bond stayed 2, so the hearts did not change and no toast says the bond is growing. I did not play long enough to see a bond level tick over.

title: Oakback golden apples: 4 glints x 1 apple, 300 s respawn, Oakback needs 14
steps: isle=meadow, walk over each of the 4 golden_apple glints (seed 21: 41,50 / 52,59 / 45,46 / 44,42)
read the rare oakback creature need
expected: Enough apples for Oakback within about 15 minutes of play
actual: Each glint gave exactly 1 golden apple (4 total, they land in the pack inv, not the pouch). Oakback's need reads 14. So 4 apples at once and 10 more means 3 respawns of 300 s = about 15 minutes standing around (my run did not wait for the respawns, no real-time confirmation). Better than round 2 (1 glint / 900 s) but a player who walks the orchard once has 4 of 14 and nothing says apples come back. Also the rare spawned only on one of two loads (live 0 on the second, as timed).

title: Wanderers turning along walls: no wall contact observed
steps: spawn hopper, puffwool, tortle, boar 7-10 tiles away on the beach
expected: Wanderers slide along walls instead of bouncing
actual: They wander normally in real time (63-236 px in 14 s) and wallBumps stayed 0, but none touched a wall in my run, so I cannot say it turns well. A second run with creatures spawned 1-2 tiles from the hero and stepped by hand showed them frozen for 40 sim seconds (probably my harness, not reproduced in real time).

title: First screen: desktop has a creature, phone shows none and the how-to card plus two toasts cover the map
steps: fresh save, open isles/index.html (jungle) at 1280x720 and 390x844 touch
expected: Something to look at on the first screen, no overlap
actual: Desktop: teal bird creature, trees and a log sparkle visible, not empty. Phone: no creature in view; the How to play card sits under the HUD over the map and two toasts (Medal: Verdant Jungle and the vine rope hint) stack above the controls. Same as b05-10 round 2, still not fixed on phone. Hearth Isle fresh start not checked.

title: Creature hit flash is a white silhouette of the creature
steps: companions=0, fire at a Thistle Boar, capture the frame the flash is active
actual: The boar is drawn as a clean white copy of its own shape (hitFlash stats sil 1 silPng 1 circle 0). No round blob. Boar hp 140 -> 126.

title: Death dissolve plays after a kill
steps: kill a boar and a hopper, render 0.05 / 0.15 / 0.3 s after death
expected: Creature dissolves instead of a hard pop
actual: Frames show the lying creature fading out; hooks report dissolve on, level 1-5, deathsShown 1, draws 5. I did not watch it in motion, only paused frames.

title: getImageData willReadFrequently warnings still logged on every load
steps: open isles at any viewport, read console
actual: Two Canvas2D getImageData warnings per load (same as b05-11).

title: Taming hint toast stays after the creature is dead
steps: fire at a Thistle Boar until it dies, look at the bottom toast
expected: Hint goes away with the creature
actual: 'Thistle Boar trusts you. Stay calm and feed it apple x4 - 0/7.' and a Feed 0/7 button remain on screen after the boar died and was dissolving (img 08).
